verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Auto Labels that classify mail on arrival, separate marketing, cold pitches and social updates, and Auto Archive low-priority messages. Split-inbox tabs and follow-up reminders surface what needs attention, and users can steer triage with custom Auto Labels written as plain-language AI prompts. missing for 10: any documented way to audit or review why the AI labeled or archived a message (e.g. explanations, logs, undo history), custom prompt-based labels gated to Business/Enterprise tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of triage accuracy.
